prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity portrait mobile app direction comp for SANAD, one complete smartphone screen, category-standard polished fintech product UI.
Primary request: Design a conventional Chat screen for SANAD, a trustworthy small-business trade-finance app. Show the bilingual brand names exactly as “SANAD” and “سند”. The conversation is between a fictional buyer, “Maya Haddad”, and fictional supplier, “Karim Benali”. Center the flow on a clearly synthetic invoice for olive oil totaling exactly “€6,000”, with a prominent but conventional bridge into financing.
Scene/backdrop: isolated straight-on portrait app viewport filling the canvas; no device mockup, hands, desk, or environmental scene.
Style/medium: crisp production-ready mobile UI screenshot, restrained contemporary fintech aesthetic, polished and credible rather than experimental.
Composition/framing: portrait 9:16. Soft gradient header with SANAD / سند branding, back button, supplier avatar and status. Conventional chat thread with readable buyer and supplier message bubbles. Include a clean invoice attachment card labeled “Olive oil invoice”, “Synthetic invoice”, “€6,000”, and a clearly visible primary button “Finance this invoice”. Below or within the bridge show concise neutral financing UI such as “Review financing options” without quoting rates, approval odds, turnaround promises, or eligibility claims. Standard bottom message composer and familiar iconography. Spacious grid, rounded white cards, careful alignment, clear hierarchy, accessible touch targets.
Color palette: background #F7F7FA, cards #FFFFFF, primary violet #7657FF, text #16151A; subtle lilac gradient in header; neutral gray borders and secondary text.
Text (verbatim): “SANAD”, “سند”, “Maya Haddad”, “Karim Benali”, “Olive oil invoice”, “Synthetic invoice”, “€6,000”, “Finance this invoice”, “Review financing options”, “Message”
Constraints: one coherent screen only; all visible claims must be fictional or neutral; clearly mark the invoice synthetic; preserve exact total €6,000; legible UI text; recognizable standard chat, attachment, send, back, phone, and info icons; clean card grid; no invented financial claims.
Avoid: interest rates, APR, approval guarantees, savings claims, speed claims, testimonials, real bank logos, third-party trademarks, charts, crypto cues, dark mode, neon cyberpunk styling, marketing poster composition, watermarks, spelling errors, duplicate controls, distorted text.
